subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr braced wrong and always thought of the wrong muscle under pressure.
source_quote: I braced wrong. I always think of the wrong muscle under pressure

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr believes his luck has a restrained, unkind sense of humor.
source_quote: He has a sense of humor, my luck, and it is not a kind one. Restrained.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr realized the salamander’s surrender was not mercy but a cold reckoning.
source_quote: Either it had made a cold reckoning and decided the odds did not favor dying here — which I respect, which is the most honest thing a creature can do

subject: Salamander's intent
fact: The salamander knelt and set down its spear, but its true motive is unspecified and suspected to be calculated.
source_quote: It stopped. It knelt. It set its flaming spear down on the stone. ... I do not know what it is.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr read the infernal contract and struck out clauses that demanded soul or ownership.
source_quote: He read it through, top to bottom, and I watched his eyes stop on the clauses near the end... He struck them out. Soul, ownership, whatever the thing was reaching for — gone

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr shook hands with the salamander despite knowing it would burn him.
source_quote: He took it anyway. 'I will die sooner,' he said, and closed his hand around the salamander's.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia confronted Calmer about not being a true Earth Temple cleric.
source_quote: You're not a real cleric for the Earth Temple.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer demanded to be called 'the Prophet of the Earth Temple' while opening the chest.
source_quote: Calmer chose the moment before the lock to demand we start calling him the Prophet, the Prophet Calmer, the Prophet of the Earth Temple.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia discovered the sword in the chest was sentient after it coughed.
source_quote: The sword coughed. A real cough. Out loud, from a length of steel that had no throat to do it with.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia was chosen by Frostbrand as the one who was 'exactly what I was looking for.'
source_quote: It looked at me. Also a possibility. And then it looked at Calmer... and instead it came back to me. 'You, you are exactly what I was looking for.'

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia revealed to Frostbrand that he had killed Romag and participated in a three-way war.
source_quote: We killed Romag. Ran a three-way war and let it eat itself. I have taken things when no one was counting.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand recognized Vorkal as its former jailor and demanded satisfaction.
source_quote: It saw the salamander. It started talking — to Vorkal, in whatever language salamanders curse in — and the whole thing turned. Old jailor, old prisoner.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand named Calmer for St. Cuthbert's, a death sentence in the temple.
source_quote: Then it caught Calmer. Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia accepted Frostbrand as his weapon, despite its coldness and danger.
source_quote: I'll take it," I said. I let it down into my actual hand, against my better judgment

subject: Sequoia
fact: Frostbrand declared that Sequoia and it would sneak around and kill creatures to defeat the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: It announced that the two of us would sneak around and kill creatures, that we would defeat the evil of the Temple of Elemental Evil and have our vengeance

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr volunteered to open the secret door to the Fire Temple commander’s chamber.
source_quote: The secret door opened north, and Zephyr volunteered to do the opening

subject: Fire Temple Commander
fact: The Fire Temple commander recognized Zephyr as the interloper who killed Alrrem and destroyed his temple.
source_quote: oh, it's you. The obsidian edge, the interlopers who killed Alrrem, destroyed my temple, massacred my forces.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr answered the Fire Temple commander’s accusation with a flat 'Yes.'
source_quote: "Yes," said Zephyr.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a professional spy who respects honesty and does not spare kindness when confronting deception.
source_quote: I said it flat. There was no kindness to spare and no point dressing it.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer is increasingly consumed by his cover identity as the Prophet of the Earth Temple, losing touch with his true self.
source_quote: The cover had started writing his objections for him.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand is a sentient sword with a long memory, bound to the Fire Temple’s history and capable of recognizing its jailor.
source_quote: Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy... Old jailor, old prisoner.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia refused to touch Frostbrand directly without a glove, suspecting a trap.
source_quote: I don't trust this. At all. I'll let the hand that isn't a hand do it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recognized the infernal contract as something tieflings have seen before.
source_quote: He didn't flinch. He's seen these before.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia interpreted the salamander’s surrender as a sign of shifted power, not mercy.
source_quote: A creature made of heat does not kneel unless the odds have already turned against it.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr accepted the salamander’s terms: it keeps the Fire Temple and kills Water Temple stragglers in exchange for intelligence.
source_quote: The terms that remained were clean enough: it keeps the Fire Temple, it kills any Water Temple stragglers still breathing, and — this was the part worth the whole exchange — it knows things.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia confirmed to Frostbrand that he had taken things when no one was counting.
source_quote: I have taken things when no one was counting. That is the file.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia told Calmer he was going too deep in his deception, and Calmer accepted it as truth.
source_quote: I think you're going in too deep." ... "I understood the art of spying, that if I told him he was going too deep, he would believe me.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia told Frostbrand they were on an undercover mission, which the sword did not weigh heavily.
source_quote: We're kind of on an undercover mission right now," I said, which it did not seem to weigh as heavily as I would have liked.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia observed that Calmer’s objections were being written by his cover identity, not his true self.
source_quote: The cover was speaking again, and it was getting louder.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia flipped the chest over to avoid triggering a trap, revealing the cold sword among the loot.
source_quote: What if I just flip the chest over? Let it fall out. The items went onto the floor in a heap.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand accepted Sequoia as its wielder despite his neutral alignment, recognizing him as exactly what it needed.
source_quote: You, you are exactly what I was looking for.
